root_cause: Production readback on 2026-10-24: bedrijfsgeheugen had 390 due 24/48/72-hour windows, 71 independently observed in-window provider snapshots still not evaluated, and 319 unmatched windows. Legacy hourly evaluator picked at most 2 due windows per tenant from sorted/rotated candidate IDs without evidence preference, repeatedly spending its full budget on missing snapshots. Canonical had 21 already-evaluated available windows and 108 missing.
fix: Extend existing social-learning-store list_due_posts with one tenant-bound metadata-only, capped (900) snapshot read; annotate exact in-window OBSERVED / PROVIDER_OBSERVED evidence. Existing hourly Netlify evaluator preferentially processes verified observation windows but reserves recurring capacity for absent-snapshot obligations. Fallback to original behavior when provider-index read is truncated. No new cron, provider sync, publisher or learning table.
prevention_rule: Do not manufacture or backfill missing metrics; quality PARTIAL_SCOPE and provider-unlinked are ineligible as verified window hints. Always validate matched snapshot again inside evaluator. Preserve tenant isolation, source evidence and bounded per-hour work. A measured window remains a sampled observation, never proven causal lift or new customer by itself.
terminal_rule: Protected exact-HEAD Required+CodeQL, merged Supabase and Netlify deploys, first new social_learning_evaluations in bedrijfsgeheugen with real snapshot links, no fabricated 0, and future next-post/outcome readback required for conversion claims.
